title: AI Simulations Grounded in Rich Self-Reports Increase Accuracy and Reduce Distortion
abstract: arXiv:2411.10109v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI simulations of people built from demographic prompts often misjudge individuals and distort sample-level patterns. We test whether rich self-report data reduce these problems. We developed an AI voice interviewer and conducted two-hour interviews following the American Voices Project protocol with 1,052 U.S. adults, who also completed surveys and behavioral experiments. For each participant, we compared simulations prompted with demographic attributes, self-authored personas, survey responses, interview responses, or combined surveys and interviews. We evaluated accuracy on held-out responses, and measured eight statistical distortions at the sample level: biased averages, compressed variance, distorted response distributions, over-correlated items, attitudes collapsing onto one dimension, ideological sorting, amplified experimental effects, and hyper-rationality. translated_title: 基于丰富自我报告数据的AI模拟可提高准确性并减少失真
translated_abstract: 基于人口统计学提示构建的人类AI模拟常常误判个体，并扭曲样本层面的统计模式。我们检验了丰富的自我报告数据是否能减少这些问题。我们开发了一个AI语音访谈系统，并按照“美国之声项目”的协议对1,052名美国成年人进行了两小时的访谈，这些受访者同时还完成了问卷调查和行为实验。针对每位参与者，我们比较了分别基于以下不同提示生成的模拟结果：人口统计学属性、自我撰写的人物画像、问卷回答、访谈回答，以及问卷与访谈相结合。我们在留出的回答数据上评估了模拟的准确性，并在样本层面测量了八种统计失真：平均值偏差、方差被压缩、回答分布失真、条目间过度相关、态度坍缩为单一维度、意识形态归类、实验效应被放大，以及过度理性。在综合社会调查（GSS）的题目上，仅基于人口统计学的模拟导致了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对1,052名美国成年人开展两小时AI语音深度访谈并结合问卷数据，证明基于丰富自我报告数据（访谈与调查）的AI人类模拟比仅用人口属性提示的模拟更准确，并能显著减少样本层面的八类统计失真。
en_tdlr: Through two-hour AI voice interviews with 1,052 U.S. adults combined with survey data, this study demonstrates that grounding AI human simulations in rich self-reports improves individual-level accuracy and substantially reduces eight types of sample-level statistical distortions compared with demographic-only prompts.
